reviews.title: Not a good experience
reviews.pros:
Its nice when it works. But it has a major negative for me,

It creates nice presentations when i can upload a pdf
reviews.cons:
I cant upload majority of my PDF files. 

It tells me inappropriate content, and this does not make sense at all.
reviews.overall:
Out of 10 books, i can only upload maybe 1 or 2

Also it does not give answers just out of your pdf, but also gives answers as ChatGPT.
